sources.snippet: Overview wangzhang/Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated is a 27 billion parameter model derived from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, developed by Wangzhang Wu. Its primary distinction is a substantial reduction in refusal behavior, achieved through a novel 10-round iterative LoRA self-distillation pipeline.
